pjm.filter: Driver contains Customer Service OR non-null Total Expected Load cell. Retain all qualifying rows regardless of sector or value; not all are new large load. No arbitrary minimum-MW cutoff.

miso.filter: All Other Type Load Growth evaluation projects plus explicit load-addition/interconnection/customer-load candidates in either evaluation or approved facility descriptions; exclude GIP. Group by MTEP Project ID; retain separate phase/support projects without summing MW.

boundaries: These are exhaustive extractions of stated source filters, not near-complete counts of all requested customer load or remaining pending MW.

PJM M-3 includes historical transmission needs, existing and transferred loads, distribution area growth, duplicate/superseded solutions, cancellations and missing customer MW. It is not a customer interconnection queue.

MISO MTEP source files cover transmission planning projects/facilities and include multiple projects serving one load, programmatic upgrades, study changes, and service states for transmission assets only.
Customer identity, sector, contracts, actual energization, remaining load and link to utility queues often remain unavailable. Missing MW remains null.
PJM source Total Expected Load (MW) label is not reliable evidence of units where Problem Statement states MVA; only exact explicit MW matches are promoted to mw.
All support rows use queueId empty, stage GU, include 0, recordType transmission_support, additive false. No summation into pending load.
